title: Trial of Francis Gary Powers – courtroom photograph
description: Black-and-white photograph of a large ornate hall with chandeliers and columns, showing a defendant standing in an enclosed dock before rows of seated spectators and court officials. Captioned "Trial of Francis Gary Powers." Chapter 4 text (page 184) discusses Powers' debriefing, DCI McCone's Board of Inquiry headed by Judge E. Barrett Prettyman, and its recommendation that he receive back pay.
